# Yume Ga Kanau™ (夢が叶う)

> An online Japanese language institute offering JLPT N5–N2 preparation,
> conversational Japanese (Kaiwa) and Business Japanese, in small batches and
> 1-on-1 coaching. Founded December 2025 by Parveen Kaur Sensei. Classes are
> fully online and open to learners worldwide; students currently join from
> India, the UK, the USA and Japan.

Tagline: Don't just learn Japanese, feel it!

## The four stages

- Stage 1 · JLPT N5 — Kana to your first conversations. Hiragana and katakana
  read without Romaji, first ~150 words, です／ます patterns, a spoken self-introduction.
- Stage 2 · JLPT N4 — Grammar that connects. て-form, plain form and past tense;
  kanji to around 300; everyday conversation and slow-speed listening.
- Stage 3 · JLPT N3 — Real-world Japanese. Kanji to around 650; transitivity,
  causative, passive and keigo foundations; natural-speed listening.
- Stage 4 · JLPT N2 — Fluency and nuance. 1,000+ kanji, formal keigo and business
  register, full JLPT exam strategy.

A six-question test at /explore recommends a starting stage.

## Policies, stated plainly

- The site sets no cookies and runs no analytics or tracking of any kind. The
  trial-class form is the only place it collects anything, and what it collects
  is emailed to the instructor rather than stored in a database.
- Fees are non-refundable once a batch begins, but a student facing unforeseen
  circumstances may request to pause their enrolment or transfer to a future
  batch.
- No JLPT result is guaranteed. Yume Ga Kanau is not affiliated with the Japan
  Foundation or JEES, who administer the JLPT.

## Common questions

- A free trial class is offered before enrolment. No payment and no commitment;
  the level is assessed and the teaching approach demonstrated.
- All study materials are included — PDF handouts, custom kanji workbooks,
  vocabulary lists and practice tests. No separate textbook purchase is required.
- Classes are scheduled across time zones including India, the UK and Japan.
- Fees are non-refundable once a batch begins.
- Switching from group to 1-on-1 later is possible, subject to slot availability.

Full answers, in the institute's own words, are on the home page under FAQ.
